# warpline

> Deterministic plugin runtime with LLM-judgment dispatch and side-effect approval gates

## Docs

- [first-plugin.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warplinehq/warpline/v0.5.0/docs/first-plugin.md): **start here**: build, run and gate a plugin in ten minutes
- [doctrine.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warplinehq/warpline/v0.5.0/docs/doctrine.md): the deterministic/LLM boundary
- [runtime-spec.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warplinehq/warpline/v0.5.0/docs/runtime-spec.md): manifest fields, retry/timeout/abort semantics, run artifacts
- [derive-dont-store.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warplinehq/warpline/v0.5.0/docs/derive-dont-store.md): why there is no snapshot store, diff engine or resource cache, and what `ttl_hours` plus one overwritten file does instead
- [needs-llm-contract.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warplinehq/warpline/v0.5.0/docs/needs-llm-contract.md): the LLM handoff protocol
- [plugin-authoring.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warplinehq/warpline/v0.5.0/docs/plugin-authoring.md): writing and testing plugins
- [scheduler-recipe.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warplinehq/warpline/v0.5.0/docs/scheduler-recipe.md): running `advance` on a fifteen-minute tick under systemd, launchd or cron, with every scheduler fact cited to the page it came from

## Optional

- [board-spec.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warplinehq/warpline/v0.5.0/docs/board-spec.md): the Board: objects, Ask lifecycle, places, form, file formats. The board is a repo-only surface, so this spec is not shipped in the package and the link is absolute. (background: not needed to use warpline)
- [why-the-gate-holds.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/warplinehq/warpline/v0.5.0/docs/why-the-gate-holds.md): the long argument: why the gate holds, and the objections it has to survive (background: not needed to use warpline)
